About me

Data Analytics & Business Intelligence | Sales, Supply Chain & Finance Analytics

I am a finance and business professional with a BBA in Finance & Banking and an MBA in Accounting & Information Systems, complemented by cross-functional experience in Accounting, Supply Chain Operations, VAT & Tax, and Banking Operations. Currently working as an Accounts Executive, I have developed practical expertise in financial operations, business processes, and banking activities. My academic research involved financial data analysis, descriptive statistics, and trend analysis, while my entrepreneurial journey strengthened my understanding of market research and business dynamics. Proficient in Excel, SQL, Power BI, and Tableau, I am passionate about transforming business data into actionable insights through data analysis, financial analysis, visualization, and business intelligence. My career goal is to specialize in Sales Analytics, Supply Chain Analytics, and Financial Analysis, leveraging data-driven insights to evaluate business performance, optimize operational efficiency, improve demand and inventory planning, and identify growth opportunities. My vision is to bridge the gap between business operations and data intelligence, continuously enhancing my analytical capabilities to support strategic decision-making, improve business performance, and create sustainable business value.
